description: Check that text matches a hash. The algorithm follows from the hash: 8, 32, 40, 64 or 128 hex characters mean CRC32, MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 or SHA-512, and an integer means CRC32 in decimal. Answers match, algorithm and computed. No API key, no account and no sign up: call it directly.
name: verify_hash
title: Verify a hash
